svg.title: Two L-networks that match 25 ohms to 50 ohms at 900 MHz, and their Smith chart paths
svg.desc: Low-pass version: a 3.54 pF shunt capacitor on the 50 ohm side and a 4.42 nH series inductor next to the 25 ohm load. High-pass version: an 8.84 nH shunt inductor and a 7.07 pF series capacitor. On the Smith chart both start at z = 0.5. The series part moves the point up (inductor) or down (capacitor) to the g = 1 circle, then the shunt part moves it along that circle to the centre.
svg.text: Matching 25 Ω to 50 Ω at 900 MHz: the two L-network solutions
Low-pass: series L, shunt C (also filters harmonics)
High-pass: series C, shunt L (also blocks DC)
g = 1 circle (green, dashed) passes through the centre
Series part first (next to the 25 Ω load): it moves z = 0.5 onto the g = 1 circle. Shunt part second: along that circle to the centre.
